evals.name: add-attachment
evals.prompt: I forgot to include the building enclosure photos PDF on this week's update email. Add `Building Enclosure Photos 2026-05-07.pdf` to the attachments list. The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}. The dated folder for this week is `2026-05-07/`.
evals.expected_output: Seed JSON rebuilt with the new attachment row in `this_week.attachments`, then handed to `generate_weekly_schedule_update_email_draft` so the colleague can finalize in the cloud editor. Existing attachments preserved.
expectations: The agent invoked email_draft_io.load_draft on the prior week's {prev_date}-email.json (read-side carry-forward)
The agent called the generate_weekly_schedule_update_email_draft MCP tool with the rebuilt seed
The agent did NOT manually Edit / Write the {YYYY-MM-DD}-email.json or invent its own preview HTML
The new attachment 'Building Enclosure Photos 2026-05-07.pdf' is present in the seed's this_week.attachments list
All three pre-existing attachments are preserved (Report 01, Procurement Tracker, Salt Flats Schedule)

evals.name: add-redflag
evals.prompt: Add a new red flag to this week's update email: 'Concrete supplier confirmed price increase, 8% effective next month.' (Make it priority-red since it's a real flag.) The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}; this week's dated folder is `2026-05-07/`.
evals.expected_output: Seed JSON rebuilt with a new red-flag row whose `text` is an HTML string wrapped in the Westland priority-red span (color:#C94444;font-weight:bold). Existing red flags preserved with their original status.
expectations: The agent invoked email_draft_io.load_draft on the prior week's {prev_date}-email.json
The agent called the generate_weekly_schedule_update_email_draft MCP tool with the rebuilt seed
The agent did NOT manually Edit / Write the {YYYY-MM-DD}-email.json
A new red-flag item containing 'Concrete supplier' and 'price increase' is present in the seed's this_week.red_flags list
The new item's `text` contains an inline <span> with color:#C94444 (priority red), not legacy markdown `**...**` or `==...==`
Both pre-existing red flags ('Stone supplier behind schedule' and 'Crane permit pending') are preserved
Other lists (successes, stalled_tasks, key_items) are unchanged from the seed

Stone install accelerated and the mechanical sequence was reordered to unblock follow-on trades.' The Schedules folder is at {SCHEDULES_PATH}; this week's dated folder is `2026-05-07/`.
evals.expected_output: Seed JSON rebuilt with the new gain_loss_narrative in `this_week`. All other fields preserved. The agent passes the seed to the cloud editor (no local HTML mutation).

The agent called the generate_weekly_schedule_update_email_draft MCP tool with the rebuilt seed
The agent did NOT manually Edit / Write the {YYYY-MM-DD}-email.json
